Name: Pragmatist's Organized Greenhouse
Author: oclarina
Description:
I like having at least one of each tree type in my greenhouse, so I made this layout for myself to fit all of the trees from vanilla, Ridgeside Village, and Stardew Valley Expanded, without massively extending the usable space of the greenhouse. And now you can use it too!

[b][u][size=4]Config[/size][/u]
[/b][size=3]Layout[/size]
﻿-Decorated: the default layout, with potted plants and other such vanilla-ish decor scattered around the edges of the greenhouse.
﻿-Empty: removes all extra decor from the greenhouse, so that you can decorate it however you like.
﻿-Off: disables this mod, in case you have a different greenhouse mod installed that you'd like to use instead.

[b][u][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/u]
[/b]This mod only edits the greenhouse interior map, so while it is incompatible with any other mods that edit the greenhouse, it is [b]fully compatible[/b] with all other mod types, including those which add new crops or trees.
